node.title: Re: Efficient but elegant Cross-Product iterator ?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: My [mod://Algorithm::Odometer::Tiny] has some [https://github.com/haukex/Algorithm-Odometer-Tiny/blob/e380f57d1/lib/Algorithm/Odometer/Tiny.pm#L22|code], in addition to a "See Also" section with quite a few references to other modules. If you want speed, forsetproduct from [mod://Math::Prime::Util] or [mod://Set::Product::XS] are probably going to be best.
